Measured 2026-11-18: apisix-ingress-controller was at Helm revision 1 on the running cluster despite PR #715 adding runAsNonRoot/readOnlyRootFilesystem --set flags to scripts/cluster/08-1-networking.sh; bootstrap-only Helm releases (apisix, apisix-ingress-controller, gitea, nfs-quota-agent, cnpg, csi-driver-nfs) lack ArgoCD Application sync, leaving script changes silently unapplied until manual helm re-run. Created scripts/test/check-bootstrap-helm-drift.sh and helper scripts/test/lib/check-bootstrap-helm-drift.py to extract literal --set/--set-string/--set-json flags from bootstrap scripts (04-addons, 05-nfs-quota-agent, 07-cnpg, 08-1-networking, 12-gitea), split comma-separated assignments (--set a=x,b=y) preserving backslash-escaped commas and braces lists, recognise wrapped helm commands (sudo, env, VAR=x, if/!/then, $(...)-free prefixes, global flags, variable forms) with fail-closed completeness verification across scripts/cluster/*.sh, enforce Helm strvals type coercion rules (true/false/null, int64 regex, strings for floats/leading zeros/exponent/hex/20-digit numbers), report releases using only values files as UNCHECKED (never false IN_SYNC), filter out shell variables ($) and secret values (password, passwd, token, adminKey; listing skipped keys by name only), sanitize error paths against secret leakage, support multi-word command overrides via read -r -a, compare against 'helm get values <release> -n <ns> -o json' via stdin pipe without temporary files, and execute mutation verification in an isolated temporary directory rejecting 18 mutations; wired R376 in regression-check-kakao.sh, added operations/test-strategy docs, and recorded lessons-log row.
